title: WeVisOne-VL: Unified Visual Perception from Objects to Pixels

problem.summary: Existing vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable for fine-grained visual perception.
statements: Existing vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable for fine-grained visual perception.
In this report, we present WeVisOne-VL (WeChat Vision All-in-One), a powerful VLM that unifies object-level and pixel-level perception through structured next-token prediction.

It supports multiple visual tasks including object detection, referring localization, counting, OCR, segmentation, and matting, enabling localization at any user-specific granularity, from points and boxes to masks and alpha mattes.
